'''Sufi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] who lived on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a galactic conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Personality and traits==
Sufi initially mistrusted of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and saw them only as agents of the Republic.
